patterns.note: Sections are primarily full-width, using a light grey background for content and vibrant, full-bleed color blocks for imagery, creating a strong visual rhythm.
Extremely large, bold, sans-serif typography is used as a dominant visual element for section titles, often spanning multiple lines and contrasting with smaller, lighter body text.
A muted, light grey serves as the primary background, providing a neutral canvas for stark black text and vibrant, saturated accent colors (green, pink, yellow, red) used in image blocks.

The initial hero text remains sticky at the top of the viewport, while a large, stylized brand graphic ('THE1') scrolls up from below, progressively covering the hero content to create a layered reveal.
Content is structured into distinct, full-width sections, each introduced by an oversized text heading, followed by either a grid of image blocks or detailed information.

technique_notes: Large, bold, sans-serif typography is used as a primary design element, often spanning multiple lines and dominating the visual space, creating a strong, almost architectural presence.
Sections are introduced with full-width, light grey backgrounds, featuring large, centered text, providing clear visual breaks and hierarchy.
Accent colors are used in distinct, full-bleed blocks containing imagery, providing energetic visual breaks and highlighting specific content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a strong visual presence, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text for details.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements and image blocks with crisp corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and ample negative space around large headings, creating a sense of openness).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely large, bold typography as a primary visual and structural element, giving the page an almost sculptural quality. This is powerfully combined with a dynamic, oversized brand graphic that scrolls to overlay and reveal content, creating a unique, layered browsing experience that feels both modern and artistic.
